Partners (the &#8220;<b><i>Fund</i></b>&#8221;) sold Class&#160;I common shares of beneficial interest (the &#8220;<b>Shares</b>&#8221;)
in an unregistered offering. The final number of Shares sold was determined on June&#160;16, 2026, as set forth in the table below:</p>

    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 1%; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 13%; text-align: right">384,766</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 1%; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 1%">&#160;</td>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The offer and sale of the Shares were not registered
under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<b><i>Securities Act</i></b>&#8221;), in reliance upon the exemptions from registration
provided by Section&#160;4(a)(2)&#160;thereof and Regulation D and/or Regulation S promulgated thereunder. The Shares were sold pursuant
to subscription agreements entered into between the Fund and the purchasers. The Fund relied, in part, on representations made by each
purchaser in its subscription agreement that such purchaser was an &#8220;accredited investor&#8221; (as defined in Regulation D under
the Securities Act) or a non-U.S. person (as defined in Regulation S under the Securities Act).</p>
